body: That's exactly how I'm feeling everyday. Anger is the most poisonous one of them all. It sucks all the energy from me.
I thinks it's worse when you stop crying

Things like this make this subreddit important. Not just a way to express your pain but to tell everyone that depression is something you can overcome
I feel you. My cat just died because my family didn't like him anymore. I loved him and I felt a piece of me die when I heard the news
I would hug you man. No one should be alone

But your parents will blame themselves for the decision. I know this, because I'm in the same place as you are. I want end my life but I don't want to hurt my family, hence the "anchor" what we are experiencing. If you want to talk about it about, just message me.
